content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

What was the average price paid for properties in Leeds (town = 'LEEDS') during the previous calendar year (2025)? Note: 'last year' is interpreted as the previous calendar year (2025). If you meant the past 365 days, please ask using 'past 365 days' instead.

content.statement:
SELECT *
FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
    ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
    METRICS average_price
    WHERE uk_price_paid.town = 'LEEDS'
    AND YEAR(uk_price_paid.date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1
)
